description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ProviderRedirectTrait' that provides redirect handling functionality for OAuth2 client providers, including methods for following redirects, managing redirect limits, and handling HTTP responses.

methods.name: followRequestRedirects
methods.description: Follows HTTP redirects up to the redirect limit, returning the final response.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the HTTP client instance.

methods.name: isRedirect
methods.description: Determines if a response is a redirect based on status code and headers.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Sends a request and returns the response, handling exceptions.

methods.name: setRedirectLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of redirects to follow, with validation.
